title: Instant Crash without Play Services
symptom: The app flashes up for a short moment (0.5 sec) and then instantly crashes when opened on a device without Google Play services or Micro G, such as GrapheneOS on Pixel 6a or an emulator without Google APIs.
cause: The crash is caused by a bug in the updated Google Play libraries, which was introduced in the 2022.09.08b release.
fix: The Dec 24th nightly resolves the issue.
